text:
Maria: FYI customer (acme-ai) reports sudden spike of 502s when streaming long responses from hosted API. Started ~0900 PST, ~40% of calls fail with 502 mid-stream. Attaching traces we have so far.

Casey: ack — can you drop one full request id + trace? also which model + region?

Maria: trace id: trace-0a1b2c3d, model: gpt-open-6b, region: us-west-2, observed on both prod and ded-demo. Payloads are large (chat history ~50k chars) and they're using streaming SSE via curl -N.

Jorge: any common error text in edge logs? envoy shows: `upstream reset: connection termination` and `HTTP/2 RST_STREAM` a lot.

Maria: paste from edge logs for trace-0a1b2c3d: 
```
[2026-03-15T09:02:41Z] envoy upstream reset reason=RESET_PEER, code=2, stream=12345, upstream_host=10.2.4.56:443, x-request-id=trace-0a1b2c3d
[2026-03-15T09:02:41Z] envoy error "recv error: connection reset by peer" on downstream
[2026-03-15T09:02:41Z] envoy error "GOAWAY received from upstream, last_stream_id=1024"
```

Arjun: GOAWAY + RST_STREAM hints at h2 connection limits / pool exhaustion. If upstream (runtime) is closing connections due to per-connection stream limit, envoy will surface those as 502s mid-stream.

Casey: customer is streaming a single long response on one stream — that should be fine, but we recently tightened circuit breaker settings on edge to protect auth tier. Could be causing connections to be closed once stream count hits threshold.

support-bot: incident-bot: new alert on edge-proxy h2-stream-exhaustion in us-west-2 (p95 increase in RST_STREAMs).

Maria: repro steps from customer: 
1) start streaming call: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-6b","input":"<very long chat history>","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
2) wait ~15-20s — ~40% of runs get `502` with partial payload delivered.

Jorge: asked dev-runtime for connection logs — they see the same stream id being abruptly reset and a log line: `stream exceeded per-connection active stream quota, closing connection`. that phrase comes from our runtime's h2 layer.

Arjun: probable root cause: mismatch between envoy's max concurrent streams and runtime's per-connection stream limits plus aggressive circuit breaker on auth proxy. When connection pool saturates, runtime closes the whole connection (GOAWAY) instead of draining streams, which causes in-flight streams to fail with 502.

Casey: actionable repro I can run locally — will simulate 100 parallel streaming clients to reproduce h2 pool exhaustion. Will also try sending large single-stream responses to reproduce the GOAWAY mid-stream.

Maria: customer asked for mitigation asap. their product is sensitive to partial outputs. Any quick mitigations we can apply?

Jorge: short-term mitigations: 
- Increase envoy h2 max_concurrent_streams and connection pool size on the auth tier in us-west-2 (can canary).
- Temporarily relax circuit_breakers on auth proxy so runtime doesn't close connections aggressively.
- Recommend customer add client-side retries with stream resume/backoff or chunk-level checkpointing (not ideal).

Arjun: long-term: make runtime gracefully drain connections on GOAWAY and ensure it completes in-flight streams when possible, or implement stream-level retries at the protocol level. Also add per-route controls so streaming-heavy routes bypass strict auth-tier breakers.

Casey: quick patch deployed to canary in us-west-2: bumped envoy http2 max_concurrent_streams 100->250 and connection pool size 10->30 for auth pool. Canary shows drop from 40%->5% 502s in 20m sample. rolling to 20% of hosts now.

Maria: relayed to customer, they see improvement in canary region testing. Asked for post-mortem and why change regressed earlier.

Arjun: root cause summary for PM/incident: config mismatch between edge envoy h2 settings and runtime per-connection stream quotas + overly aggressive circuit breakers introduced in latest auth deployment (2026-03-14). Fix: harmonize defaults, add telemetry to detect pool saturation, and add graceful GOAWAY draining behavior in runtime.

Casey: follow-ups:
- Roll change to 100% in us-west-2 after 1h observation if no regressions.
- Create a quick runbook entry for support: when you see GOAWAY + RST_STREAM for streaming routes, increase h2 pool and check runtime stream quota.
- Create PR to revert the auth-tier circuit breaker tightening and replace with more targeted per-route limits.

Maria: thanks — I'll send customer a summary and ETA. cc @oncall-bot to keep watch overnight. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: scheduled oncall rotation for us-west-2 watch window 2026-03-15 10:00-18:00 PST.

Casey: leaving this thread open for postmortem notes. adding trace ids and perf graphs to the incident doc. :mag:
